scope: Bounded known-ID proposal, exact arithmetic and model endpoints; actual unchanged F26 helper only. No new ledger implementation/handler/save acceptance.

f26CrossFamily.note: Existing F26 single pass stays first and separate. A later new-family credit can make an earlier F26 claim payable on another canonicalization.

limitations: The 1083C bound excludes unchanged F26 claims and all daily/login/quest income.
Existing earned Deeds are historically settled at migration by convention; no unseen historical loss can be reconstructed.
One pass is not a numerical fixed point. Settled IDs cannot pay twice; due IDs keep original amounts.
Primary/recovery checks above are design model endpoint checks, not new product fault tests.
A huge or unsuitable fractional wallet may retain all due claims indefinitely; no wallet rounding or partial settlement is permitted.
